prompt:
Create ONE exceptionally refined minimalist editorial BOOK SPREAD concept for the Russian book "Почему так" by Сергей Отческов. Two facing portrait pages, each 190x250mm, combined aspect ratio 1.52:1. Flat straight-on artwork, pages filling the image, hairline central fold, no tabletop, no hands holding book, no perspective mockup, no collage of multiple spreads.

REFERENCE 1 (image 17): study its precise modular alignments, quiet typographic refinement, image sizes and intelligent white space. REFERENCE 2 (image 10): study the THIRD spread's asymmetric photo/text relationships and actual reading capacity. Adapt these structural qualities into an original composition. The user demands PREMIUM MINIMALISM WITH MEANING and has REJECTED acid colors, gigantic grotesk headlines, retro styling and repetitive advertising-poster compositions.

Neutral pure white paper, soft black text, natural subdued color only inside photographs. No colored blocks, no lime, no electric blue, no gold, no beige vintage treatment, no paper grain. Excellent contemporary Cyrillic typography with normal-width elegant medium sans headings (not heavy, not condensed, not monospaced); body in an exceptionally legible restrained contemporary text face. Typographic character through proportions and spacing, not novelty. Main heading modest, approx 25pt at physical page scale, body approx 11.5pt/16pt. Generous but purposeful outer margins. Readable book typography. No big chapter numeral, no huge quotation, no pills/cards/shadows/ornamental lines or decorative arrows.

Meaningful concept: context changes our interpretation of an empty chair. LEFT PAGE: small top label "03 / Почему так"; restrained two-line heading "Что осталось\nза кадром" top left. Beneath heading a compact introductory paragraph. Across middle/lower left page a beautifully composed rectangular contemporary editorial photograph: a charcoal metal empty chair at a communal table in a clean stone urban courtyard, white cups and bread, parts of two people talking beyond the chair. Natural neutral daylight, contemporary people and furniture, quiet documentary-like image, not rustic/vintage. The empty chair off-center, a small ordinary object in a believable environment, not an oversized product. Photo approx 72% of left page width and 43% page height, aligned asymmetrically with generous left gutter. Tiny discreet caption underneath "Иллюстративная сцена. Пустое место у общего стола." Left page bottom has a short paragraph, not a slogan.

RIGHT PAGE: one substantial reading column of genuine Russian prose occupying approx 60% page width, beginning above the midpoint and continuing to lower area. In top outer corner a smaller close detail showing the same chair's seat, a restrained rectangular crop echoing the photo on left, with a tiny caption "Деталь без окружения". It occupies at most 20% of the page area; place it with exact grid alignment. No diagram or fabricated measurements. This is a conceptual editorial photo pairing, not a scientific proof. A narrow side note at bottom outer edge "Что исчезает вместе с краем кадра?" must be modest, secondary and aligned, no boxed callout. Small page numbers 16 and 17 at outer lower corners. Rich enough for reading, no vast empty half-page, no crowded text.

Use the following EXACT Russian prose, distributed naturally in real paragraphs across both pages, no invented filler, no repeated text:
"Посмотри на стул у стола. На нем никто не сидит. Это пока единственное, что мы знаем наверняка о выбранном месте.
На столе чашки и хлеб, дальше разговаривают люди. Мне хочется прочитать картинку как приглашение присесть. Но снимок не сообщает, свободен ли стул. Возможно, человек ненадолго отошел. Возможно, он ждет кого-то другого. Изображение оставляет место для догадки, и я уже успел его заполнить.
В нашем приглашении «Ближе» этот кадр получит конкретную работу. Рядом появятся название встречи, дата и фраза о знакомстве с соседями. Они направят прочтение. Без этих слов фотография могла бы сопровождать совсем другой рассказ.
Я не вижу в этом недостатка. Мне важно заметить, какую часть истории приносит сам кадр, какую текст, а какую я достраиваю из привычки."
Optional small internal heading before last paragraphs: "За рамкой тоже что-то есть". Prioritize beautiful precise book design and readable complete paragraphs, restrained contemporary luxury art-publishing sensibility with intellectual purpose.
